Fictional websites (reserved `.example` domains) used by the airrp_entity tests. They imitate the layouts real
corporate sites use (footer links, corporate-data tables, definition lists, Impressum blocks, JSON-LD, hreflang,
country selectors) but every organisation, number and address here is invented; identifiers carry valid check digits.

- `northwind/`  UK bank/insurer group: legal notice, regulatory page (FCA/PRA, FRN), LEI, hreflang, country selector, office directory, robots.txt
- `sakura/`     Japanese listed manufacturer: corporate data list, corporate number, Tokyo Stock Exchange, Japanese name, group-companies list
- `beispiel/`   German GmbH: Impressum with Handelsregister and USt-IdNr.
- `psu/`        Indian government company: CIN with GOI class
- `sakura-europe/` website of a Sakura subsidiary (linked from the parent site), matched to its GLEIF record
- `bare/`       a page that states nothing about the entity (nothing may be invented)
- `gleif/`      registry responses in the shape of the public GLEIF API (api.gleif.org)
